blocker: Resolved by the Tier-1 httpRequest includeInput option. Residual: Tier-2 PATCH conditional support is ifVersion/If-Match (optimistic CAS); concurrent conflicts return 409 and must surface to the user.
requiredEnabler: Engine prior-node context (e.g. $node["Validate"]) or a Tier-2 conditional/merge update contract with tenant/product authz and audit.
widgetActionGap: DX action vocabulary is create|update|delete|execute; these transitions are bound with action=update and workflowRef in the plugin bundles.

invariants: the dispatch order must exist and belong to the caller tenant
the order must have an assigned_resource_unit_id (or a legacy assignment carrying the same id) before completion
completed_at is captured once so the audit timestamp is stable
a completed/canceled order cannot be rejected again
the rejected order keeps its assignment history

idempotentWhen.behaviour: return the latest existing AAR id without any write

createBefore.invariant: create the AAR first; only then resolve the event so a dependency failure never leaves a resolved event without an AAR. The AAR event_end and event ended_at must be the same close timestamp.

versioning.reuse: the latest existing AAR for the event is reused; a new version is created only when no AAR exists (legacy force-regenerate semantics)

invariants: an already resolved event is idempotent and returns the existing AAR id with no write
AAR KPI computation must match the SOS domain formula (response/dispatch/sitrep/resource) in apps/sos-service/src/after-action.ts
the AAR is a draft; publication is a separate workflow action
the AAR is versioned by event and an existing AAR is reused instead of duplicated

implementation: Implemented with the Tier-1 httpRequest includeInput:true option: GET -> code invariants/merge -> PATCH full data with ifVersion optimistic CAS. Event close additionally queries dispatch/SITREP/resource/AAR records, reuses the versioned AAR, then resolves the event. Source-ready, inactive until DX binds credentialRef and pins artifacts.
corePrimitive: GET with includeInput:true returns {statusCode, body, input}; merge the action over the full record; PATCH {data, ifVersion}. A stale version returns 409 version_conflict and fails the run.
